entries.title: Ley 24449 del 23/12/94
entries.conversionMethod: Scripted extraction from official HTML body to Markdown paragraphs; Windows-1252 source decoded to UTF-8; inline emphasis and links flattened to visible text.

currentness.statusEvidence: Official InfoLeg texact page was retrieved successfully and contains updated amendment notes, including 2025 amendment/currentness notes in the visible text.

exactTextValidation.notes: This slice performed source retrieval, conversion, local hashing, and preliminary currentness checks only. Dedicated whole-archive exact-text validation is reserved for Slice G.
